Title: Great crust
Review: The crust was crisp outside and soft inside. The margherita was excellent.

Title: Vegan option
Review: The vegan pizza with vegetables was tasty, and the staff knew which cheese was dairy free.

Title: Long wait
Review: We waited almost forty minutes after ordering. The pizza was fine but arrived lukewarm.

Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Warm lighting and comfortable seating. It was a pleasant place for dinner with friends.

Title: Too salty
Review: The sauce was too salty for my taste and the toppings were unevenly spread.

Title: Good service
Review: Our server was friendly and helped us choose a vegetarian pizza. Service was quick.

Title: Vegan cheese
Review: There is a vegan cheese option, but I found it bland. The vegetable toppings were fresh.

Title: Family friendly
Review: Plenty of space for families and a small kids menu. The garlic bread was popular with everyone.

Title: Expensive
Review: The food tasted good, although the portions felt small for the price.

Title: Excellent takeaway
Review: Our takeaway order was ready on time and the pizza was still hot when we got home.
